notes:
SMB inbound from product hunt link. Self-serve signup, low friction. Team = 8 engs + 2 PMs (support product). Primary intent: power in-app support assistant + document search. Created API key and did initial sanity tests but usage fell to near-zero after first week.

Observed: only ~12 API calls (mix of embeddings + chat) after claiming credits. Latency reported acceptable on first run (~230ms median) but they questioned per-embedding costs. SE did quick cost calc and sent examples.

Quoted from demo: "we like the latency but need to validate cost at scale — embeddings are the unknown. Might spin up OpenAI trial in parallel."

Security: asked for SOC2 attestation and SSO/SAML support — accepted hosted if SOC2 + audit logs. Started security questionnaire (linked doc) but did not finish.

Engagement history: AE reached twice, SE did 1 walkthrough, automated nudges sent. No purchase action. Customer signalled they are leaning to competitor trial because of pricing and existing integrations.

Next best move: offer 2-week top-up credit tied to a small guided PoC (docs -> embeddings cost projection + prebuilt prompt templates) and schedule 20m to unblock. If no response by 2026-03-17 mark as at-risk churn and escalate to growth for reactivation campaign.
